narr: Thunderstorms repeatedly trained Southwestward across Morgan County, producing large swaths of rainfall amounts between 3 to 6 inches over 2-3 hours on the evening of the 25th.
ev: Trained spotter reported 6 to 8 inches of moving water across the intersection of Highway 31 and Lacon Road.
lsr: TRAINED SPOTTER REPORTED 6 TO 8 INCHES OF MOVING WATER ACROSS INTERSECTION OF HIGHWAY 31 AND LACON ROAD.
